I'm sorry about the mix-up. Our policies don't cover wrong-item deliveries, so I can't promise a specific resolution or timeframe, but I can escalate this to a Support Lead. If you share your order number (LF- followed by six digits), I'll include it in the escalation.

Pothos isn't pet-safe, though peperomia is. If you have pets, keep the pothos out of their reach until this is sorted out. If a pet or person may have eaten any of it, contact a vet, doctor or poison control right away.

Would you like me to escalate this now?
